questions.stem: The case below gives the figures. A site register has 1998 users; each record must be read with alternative text in mind. What does alternative text mean in this record?

options.text: A caption for search engines only
options.misconception: Confuses alternative text with search captions

options.text: A file name of the image
options.misconception: Confuses alternative text with file names

options.text: A color code of the image
options.misconception: Confuses alternative text with color codes

questions.explanation: alternative text: Alternative text describes an image in words so screen reader users can understand its content and purpose. Option C is correct: Text describing an image. Option A is wrong because it confuses alternative text with search captions. Option B is wrong because it confuses alternative text with file names. Option D is wrong because it confuses alternative text with color codes.
questions.hint: How does a blind user learn what an image shows?
